senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חטב)to cut, chisel, hew, shape.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Yoma 1:6">Tosef. Yoma I, 6</cite> <he>כשהוא חוֹצֵב</he> engaged in stone-breaking; Sifra Emor ch. I, Par. 2; Tanḥ. Emor 4 <he>ח׳ אבנים</he>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 26">Lev. R. s. 26</cite> <he>ח׳ באבנים</he>.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Moed Katan 1:6:4">Y. M. Kat. I, 80ᵈ</cite> <he>לא יַחְצוֹב</he> one must not cut stones &c.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 854:3">Yalk. Deut. 854</cite> <he>אתה חֲצוֹב וכ׳</he> chisel thou the tablets &c.; a. fr.—Part. pass. <cite ref="H01505"><he>חָצוּב</he></cite>, f. <cite ref="H01508"><he>חֲצוּבָה</he></cite>; pl. <he>חֲצוּבִים</he>, <he>חֲצוּבוֹת</he>. Y. M. Kat. l. c. Y. Shek. VI, 49ᵈ bot.; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be hewn, chiselled. Y. Yoma III, 40ᶜ bot. בקודש יֵחָצֵבוּ on sacred ground they must be chiselled.—Trnsf. (cmp. גזר) to be decided, decreed.
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5:5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 22:16">Is. XXII, 16</cite>) <he>ממרום נ׳ עליו</he> from on high it has been decreed over him; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 291">Yalk. Is. 291</cite> <he>נֶחְצְבָה עליו גזירה</he>.
